description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nalawalana, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420508 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (Parcels 49, 50, and 92) with detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner names, identity numbers, and ownership details. The content is entirely focused on land registration and title settlement, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
